title: Who can participate?
content: HackDartmouth welcomes college and high school students of all experience levels. Beginners are encouraged!

title: How much does it cost?
content: It’s completely free. We provide food, swag, and space thanks to our sponsors.

title: Do I need a team?
content: No. You can join solo or form a team of up to 4 during the event.

title: What should I bring?
content: Bring your laptop, charger, and any hardware you’d like to hack on.
